summary: Validated two-step auth (invite gate + Emergent Google OAuth session) end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (gate correct/wrong, /auth/session missing header 400 + bogus id 401, /auth/me unauth 401 + cookie 200 + Bearer 200, POST /workouts requires cookie, PATCH/DELETE owner-only with 401/403/404 branches, POST /auth/logout deletes user_sessions row and subsequent /me is 401, public /leaderboard + /workouts). Frontend: Playwright with seeded Mongo user + injected session_token cookie confirmed (1) no-cookie /board redirects to /enter Step 01, (2) wrong invite code shows 'Invalid invite code' toast and stays on Step 01, (3) SWEAT2026 advances to Step 02 exposing google-signin-btn + wrong-code-btn, (4) google-signin-btn navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<encoded origin>/board, (5) seeded cookie -> /board renders Dashboard with 'FE PLAYWRIGHT' header + placeholder avatar img, (6) signout-btn calls /api/auth/logout, redirects to /enter Step 01, and /api/auth/me returns 401.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes datetime storage: users.created_at is stored as ISO string on insert but User model expects datetime; find_one path relies on Pydantic coercing str->datetime which works but is fragile. Consider consistent datetime storage.
_load_user_from_token assumes expires_at is not None; if a session row is malformed it will raise. Add defensive check.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec and browsers block it. Currently the frontend and backend share an origin so it happens to work; recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS explicitly to the frontend origin before enabling cross-origin usage.
Legacy seed users (Alex/Bailey/Casey/Dana/Riley) still show on the leaderboard without user_id/email/picture from the pre-OAuth schema — safe to prune.
test_credentials: Invite code SWEAT2026. Auth requires seeded Mongo session_token cookie (see /app/auth_testing.md).
seed_data_creation: Backend module-scoped fixtures seed OWNER + OTHER users/sessions and clean up on teardown. Frontend test seeded 'FE Playwright' user + tok_FE_* session (cleaned up post-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flow is solid. If leaderboard totals matter, note Emergent-side test data (TEST_Owner_ED ~200pts from iteration_3, plus new TEST_AUTH_OWNER workouts from this run) leaks into /api/leaderboard. Consider a global cleanup fixture that purges any user with user_id starting with 'user_TEST_' or 'user_OWNER_'/'user_OTHER_'.
